findings.current: अभी {count, plural, one {इस सत्र को} other {{count, number, ::group-off} सत्रों को}} रोकें
findings.proposed: अभी {count, plural, =0 {{count, number, ::group-off} सत्र को} one {इस सत्र को} other {{count, number, ::group-off} सत्रों को}} रोकें
findings.reason: Hindi CLDR routes 0 to one, so the visible zero-selection state falsely says “this session”; an explicit =0 arm preserves the existing one/other arms and renders 0 सत्र को accurately.
findings.evidence: intl-messageformat 12.1.3: n=0/category=one => अभी इस सत्र को रोकें; n=1 => अभी इस सत्र को रोकें; n=2/category=other => अभी 2 सत्रों को रोकें. destination-pickers.tsx:3106 derives chosen and :3168 always renders chosen.length, including 0; :3173 only disables submit. Proposed formatter samples: 0 => अभी 0 सत्र को रोकें; 1 => अभी इस सत्र को रोकें; 2 => अभी 2 सत्रों को रोकें; 1234 => अभी 1234 सत्रों को रोकें.

findings.reason: The established Hindi Forget action is भुलाएँ in ui.browser.browser_approvals_dock.forget_this_site; भूलें is a less idiomatic intransitive calque and introduces terminology drift.
Use the same established भुलाएँ action as the existing Forget-site copy and the companion button so the confirmation names the destructive action idiomatically and consistently.
